result.title: PCD: Predictive Coding Dynamics for Irregularly Sampled Time Series
result.comment: 15 pages. Supplementary material (2 pages) available as an ancillary file
result.summary: Dynamic systems evolve continuously over time, whereas observations in real scenarios are often sparse, irregular, and asynchronous. Accurate prediction therefore requires inferring latent state evolution between observations, as future values depend on partially observed trajectories. We propose Predictive Coding Dynamics (PCD), a residual feedback mechanism for irregular continuous dynamic models. PCD maintains previous reconstructions, predicts observed entries from them, and incorporates masked signed residuals into state recognition through an energy penalty. The mechanism is implemented with ODE-RNN and Latent ODE, supporting event-based hidden updates and latent state recognition. Experiments on forecasting and trajectory recovery tasks show that PCD improves continuous dynamic backbones under sparse and irregular sampling. The results further indicate that predictive error feedback improves latent state estimation when observations constrain the current trajectory. These results suggest that PCD provides a residual feedback framework that jointly supports trajectory generation, observation consistency checking, and state refinement in continuous-time series modeling. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PCD-for-paper-92F1/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Predictive Coding Dynamics（PCD），一种用于不规则采样连续时间序列模型的残差反馈机制：保留上一步重建结果并由其预测已观测项，再将掩码后的符号残差以能量惩罚形式并入状态识别，在 ODE-RNN 与 Latent ODE 上实现事件驱动的隐状态更新与潜状态推断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测误差经能量惩罚回灌以细化 latent 状态」的循环更新结构，可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中推理状态的迭代修正与观测一致性检验；但原文面向时间序列预测，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。
